meaning.implemented: Repository work and its acceptance evidence are complete.
meaning.in_progress: Repository work is being implemented or verified on this branch.
meaning.ready_for_execution: Runbook or template exists, but a human or elapsed-time activity must occur.
meaning.blocked_external_evidence: The task cannot honestly pass until external evidence exists.
meaning.conditional: Do only after its stated evidence gate.

evidence.EQ-01: ops/architecture-and-deploy-audit.md records the local stack and boundaries; production host parity still requires production access.
evidence.EQ-02: ops/source-rights-ledger.json exists and intentionally leaves unresolved rights blocked.
evidence.EQ-03: ops/critical-record-audit.json freezes 20 records; exact-offer parsing and visible unknown/stale states are enforced.
evidence.EQ-04: ops/ownership-and-corrections.md defines the process, but named primary and backup operators are still unassigned.
evidence.EQ-05: Vendor ordering is neutral and disclosed; copied ratings are removed; promotional affiliated treatment is disabled and the remaining Wcash reference discloses ownership.
evidence.EQ-06: ops/analytics-event-contract.md defines the baseline, allowed events, privacy boundaries and missing-data treatment.
evidence.EQ-10: Per-field evidence clocks and claim history were added, but protocol epoch/version evidence remains a reviewed editorial dependency.
evidence.EQ-11: The product now fails closed on stale and missing inputs, but lawful disconnected-source operation cannot pass until source rights and two unaffiliated paths are confirmed.
evidence.EQ-12: The calculator supports the manual workflow; a real operator session is still required.
evidence.EQ-13: The setup/evidence workflow is implemented and mobile reviewed.
evidence.EQ-16: Offer claim clocks/history are implemented; full protocol epoch semantics wait on EQ-10 and the day-30 branch decision.
evidence.EQ-17: Last-good optional reload, safe collectors and field validity are implemented; source independence still depends on EQ-11.
evidence.EQ-18: Missing/zero/stale inputs, accepted-rate basis and pool term semantics are implemented; epoch/reorg behavior remains gated by EQ-10.
evidence.EQ-19: No-account local setup, dated assumptions and unsupported-attribution states are implemented without placing private inputs in URLs.
evidence.EQ-20: Structured search now indexes coins, ASICs, pools, vendors, industry and guides with aliases, filters, stable scoring and workflow continuity.
evidence.EQ-21: Desktop and 390px mobile review, keyboard entry, focus styles and reduced motion checks passed locally.
evidence.EQ-22: Application collectors are allowlisted and SSRF constrained; production MFA, host egress and publisher controls require external evidence.
evidence.EQ-23: ops/ownership-and-corrections.md and ops/operations-drills.md are executable runbooks; named operators are needed to run them.
evidence.EQ-24: Five repository-verifiable gates pass; source rights, staffing, comprehension, drills and independent release-sample review remain open.
evidence.EQ-36: The parser binds variant, price, currency and status to the same offer and has 15 focused regression tests.
evidence.EQ-37: Current positive availability expires, failed refreshes become unknown, future batches remain preorders, and Apexto/BITMAIN conflicts are reconciled.
evidence.EQ-38: Malformed or deceptively empty optional datasets preserve last-good state, surface reload errors and retry.
evidence.EQ-39: Copied review statistics are not published; ordinary profile links remain; promotional affiliated material is disabled.
